title: The capability tool returns exactly the package's declared signature
statement: The registered Kiln capability tool, called in a session that loaded the package, returns the package's own versioned signature declaration unchanged: the same version and the same resource names the package declares, with nothing added, dropped or rewritten in transit. A session that did not load the package has no such tool to call, and that difference is what a consumer comparing an expected signature against a returned one relies on.
notes: ⚠️ TSK-0045's STATEMENT ALREADY PROMISED THIS AND NOTHING ACCEPTED IT. That task registers the research and validation adapters, delegation, AND the Kiln capability signature, but its only criterion was ACC-0065, which is about the write discipline of mutation wrappers. The capability tool could have been registered wrongly, or not at all, without a single criterion noticing. ⚠️ THE PACKAGE DECLARES, THE TOOL RETURNS, A CONSUMER COMPARES. ACC-0063 covers the declaration agreeing with the manifest; this covers the tool handing that declaration back intact; ACC-0075 covers a delegation refusing a child whose signature is absent or drifted. Three criteria, three owners, one chain - and no single one of them is the whole claim.
